subject.title: fix(googlechat): media downloads can grow unbounded without a size cap

question: Should omitted `maxBytes` on the exported Google Chat media helper mean the documented 20 MiB channel default instead of an uncapped download?
rationale: The patch fixes an unbounded media response path, but it changes exported helper behavior for direct callers that omitted a cap, so maintainers should intentionally accept that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
options.body: Land this patch with the documented Google Chat media default and require direct callers that need larger media to pass explicit `maxBytes`.

options.title: Pause for a different API contract
options.body: Hold the PR if omitted `maxBytes` should keep a different public meaning, then document and test that contract before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
recommendation.body: Land this patch with the documented Google Chat media default and require direct callers that need larger media to pass explicit `maxBytes`.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the cap-alignment commit and already framed the branch as ready for the serialized landing slot.
